At WAIYS, you work closely with our AI engineering team to build, maintain, and improve deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling for live AI-driven products. You’ll work with containerization, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and real-time systems powering AI applications such as robotics, agentic AI, and large-scale inference. About WAIYS WAIYS is a Norwegian-German tech company on a mission to simplify AI adoption in the real estate industry. We combine advanced AI software, robust infrastructure, and deep domain expertise to build modular AI SaaS for real estate investors, developers, and managers. Our solutions range from chatbots to advanced analytics to full agentic automations. Role Overview As a DevOps Engineer at WAIYS, you will build, maintain, and improve deployment pipelines for our AI systems. You will work hands-on with containerization, automation, cloud infrastructure, and real-time systems powering AI applications such as robotics, agentic AI, and large-scale inference. What you’ll work on: Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab Build, test, and maintain Docker images and containerized services. Deploying of microservices across cloud environments. Maintain internal development tooling, scripts, monitoring dashboards, and environment automation. Documentation of DevOps processes, deployment guidelines, and platform maintenance. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, container-level issues, access/token problems, and environment Design and implement automation solutions using SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Power BI, Power Automate (Flow), and Microsoft Teams to streamline workflows, improve data visibility, and enhance operational efficiency. Implementation of security feature to cloud infrastructure Contribute to backup and recovery strategy What you bring: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field 1–2 years of industry experience in DevOps or IT infrastructure Strong knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and system administration Hands-on experience with Docker, Git, GitLab or GitHub, and CI/CD concepts Familiarity with Python environment setup Practical experience with Azure cloud infrastructure Knowledge of cloud application security Exposure to DevOps, MLOps, cloud automation, or AI workflows Ability to work with Microsoft 365 automation tools such as SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Power BI, Power Automate, and Microsoft Teams Strong English communication;
